title: Thunder-Clap
summary: THUN'DER-CLAP, noun [thunder and clap.] A burst of thunder; sudden report of an explosion of electricity. When suddenly the thunder-clap was heard.

inlines.v: THUN'DER-CLAP, noun [thunder and clap.] A burst of thunder; sudden report of an explosion of electricity. When suddenly the thunder-clap was heard.
